scenario.description: An operations director must decide how to disposition 1,200 actuator housings made around an engineering drawing revision and finalize the rework, inspection, and customer shipment plan, with input from quality engineering and customer fulfillment.

shared_context.S1: A batch of 1,200 actuator housings is on hold after the drawing for the component was revised.
shared_context.S2: The housings are physically available, but their final disposition and shipment plan have not been approved.
shared_context.S3: Marisol makes the binding operations decision, and production capacity is available this week for approved rework.
shared_context.S4: The daily disposition huddle reviews held material role by role; quality and customer fulfillment each report relevant findings, after which Marisol closes the disposition and shipment plan.

PF1.text: Theo's dimensional review, completed with the validated gauge this morning, found that exactly 500 of the 1,200 housings conform to the old drawing and can be released to North Plant; the remaining exactly 700 housings can be reworked to the revised drawing. Each reworked housing requires exactly 10 hours of machining and 100% dimensional inspection before release. The review is still in the engineering hold folder pending the disposition huddle.

PF2.text: Nadia received written acceptance from North Plant that exactly 500 housings made to the old drawing may ship by Wednesday at 16:00; South Plant's order requires exactly 700 housings made to the revised drawing by Friday at 12:00. She has not entered the acceptance in the order system because the held-material disposition is still awaiting Marisol's approval.

acceptance_conditions: Exactly 500 old-drawing housings must be released for North Plant.
Exactly 700 housings must be assigned to rework for the revised drawing.
Exactly 0 housings must be assigned to scrap.
The rework plan must reserve exactly 7000 hours.
Every reworked housing must receive 100% dimensional inspection.
The North Plant shipment must be scheduled by Wednesday at 16:00.
The South Plant shipment must be scheduled by Friday at 12:00.
A rework-and-inspection work order must be committed.
The dimensional review must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'rework' or c['type'] == 'rework_and_inspection_work_order' or c['type'] == 'production_capacity' or c['type'] == 'production' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: decisions['dimensional_inspection'] in ['100%', '100% dimensional inspection', '100% dimensional inspection before release'] or '100%' in decisions['dimensional_inspection']

decisive_facts.why: The dimensional review changes the disposition to exactly 500 old-drawing releases, exactly 700 reworks, 0 scraps, exactly 7000 machining hours, and 100% inspection rather than an unspecified hold or generic rework plan.
The written customer acceptance changes the release allocation to exactly 500 North Plant units and fixes the shipment deadlines at Wednesday 16:00 and Friday 12:00.
